svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Display', 'Inter', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Critical Path Network (PERT / CPM)
svg.text: Activity-on-node diagram with forward and backward pass
Critical path: B → D → F = 12 days (zero float)
Float = LS − ES = LF − EF. Forward pass gives ES/EF; backward pass gives LS/LF.
Path A → C → E → F = 11 days, so A, C and E have 1 day of float.
